name: Seimeiin Tomoe
source:
Of the Shamans who reside within Takamagahara, she showed the most potential. She is actually capable of sustaining the Divine Beast Tamamo within her body, allowing it to possess her when necessary. At first, she was a willing servant of the Imperial court, but thanks to Tamamo, she was able to break out of their control willingly. Although innocent and naive about the ways of the world, she is a very kindhearted and merciful individual.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
